articles.title: Scientists Confirm an Ancient Asteroid Hit the North Sea
articles.summary: Tiny shocked crystals prove that the Silverpit Crater under the North Sea was made by an asteroid about 43 to 46 million years ago.

articles.title: Giant Pharaoh Head Found in Egyptian Yard
articles.summary: A homeowner's find in an Egyptian village led archaeologists to a giant stone head of Pharaoh Ramesses II and possibly a lost temple.

articles.title: Charged Raindrops Can Slowly Eat Away at Metal
articles.summary: Scientists found that raindrops charged by sliding over leaves or glass can wear through protective coatings and corrode metal.
